In this unique opportunity as a PHD candidate, you will be conducting applied research in the Research Centre of Hotelschool The Hague in close collaboration with our Lector Alexander Schmidt, while being guided as a PHD candidate by our colleagues of the VU Amsterdam. You will conduct applied research relevant to our almost 100-year-old institute, a beacon in the hospitality business, while obtaining your PHD.
A key aspect of this position is your curiosity and ability to explore and apply applied research in a practical context. You continuously investigate emerging digital tools, analyze their relevance for the hospitality industry and educational practice, and assess their pedagogical impact. Through applied research and evidence-informed experimentation, you identify opportunities for innovation and support well-founded decision-making within the programme.
You design and organise engaging workshops and learning experiences for students, connecting digital and technological developments to real-world hospitality contexts. Examples include VR-based classes, immersive learning environments, AI applications, data-driven decision-making tools, and other innovative formats that prepare students for a rapidly evolving industry.
As a true connector, you actively connect colleagues, departments, and ideas. You collaborate closely with the IT and Maintenance Departments to realize and implement your ideas in the classroom, ensuring technical feasibility, sustainability, and scalability. You will further develop HTH living labs in the Real-life learning environment by setting up and conducting research on technology in hotel operations.
You are an entrepreneur within our organization: someone who spots opportunities, takes initiative, experiments responsibly, and turns innovative ideas into concrete educational impact.
Candidate Profile
You have/are:
A strong passion for the latest developments in digital technology
Experienced in (applied) research
A research mindset combined with a hands-on mentality: you get things done
A passion for both technology and hospitality
Excellent stakeholder manager
Able to touch base with technology providers and industry partners
Able to deep dive into matters
Willing to do field visits: this project is not conducted from behind your desk only, but aims to connect with external partners & stakeholders.
Remuneration
Hotelschool The Hague offers a salary based on scale 10 of the labour agreement of Universities of Applied Science (CAO HBO) with a range between € 3.826,54 and € 5.699,76 per month, depending on your professional experience and qualifications. The duration of the contract will be 4 years.
In addition, Hotelschool The Hague offers:
A 13th month
An excellent package of fringe benefits
Employees with a 40-hour working week are entitled to 428 hours (53 days) of leave annually with retention of salary
Excellent opportunities for further personal development
Compensation towards your health insurance expenses
Option to make use of group discounts for multiple insurances
Travel allowances for commuting to and from work
A pension plan through ABP
Most importantly, you would work for an organization that strives to have a positive impact on society, helping to develop future leaders in the hospitality industry.
Additional information
Hotelschool The Hague works with a 40-hour workweek. The starting date for this position is as soon as possible depending on the notice period of the applicant. You will be working on both our campuses The Hague & Amsterdam.
An English language proficiency test may be part of the selection procedure. Upon receiving an offer, a certificate of conduct (VOG) is required. Interviews will take place Wednesday 30 September.

Are you ready to make the difference? We look forward to receiving your English CV and motivation letter. Kindly submit your CV and motivation letter to the attention of Mr. Menno Koeslag, HR Advisor.

We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

ntic way.Furthermore, you are energized by stakeholder management and are well adept at gathering reliable information. You use this in combination with a consultive mindset to make our clients more succesful.

About KPN and Network Services: KPN harnesses technology to securely connect everyone in the Netherlands to a sustainable future. The Network Services unit within B2CS maintains a high-performance network and leads AI-driven innovation, paving the way to a fully autonomous network.

Our agentic AI & Data department: tasked with realizing a fully autonomous network. Positioned at the forefront of network and service transformation, we build, configure and operate agentic AI solutions to deliver faster resolution, higher reliability and a step-change in customer experience across network and service domains. We are currently working on the Broadband Disruption Agent (DBA), expanding to On-Site Technician Support (OTS) agent for the mechanics, and moving into more production-grade solutions in our Agentic platform.

We are a young, international team with a strong learning mindset, combining deep technical expertise with enthusiasm for building real-world autonomous AI solutions.

Job Description
As an AI Engineer, you will design, build and maintain agentic AI solutions that power KPN’s move towards autonomous networks—creating intelligent agents that can observe, decide, and act to optimize performance in real time. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders (across TDO and CM), domain experts, and engineering teams to develop scalable AI solutions and platforms to bring autonomous capabilities reliably into our operational processes.

Key daily responsibilities:

- Build, develop, and maintain agentic AI systems that enable autonomous network optimization and decision-making (e.g. the disruption broadband agent).

- Make system designs, validate software quality, check run-time behavior and focus on production ownership.

- Build and maintain scalable AI/ML pipelines with a strong focus on reliability, performance and maintainability.

- Define and implement monitoring, testing, and governance strategies to ensure robustness and compliance of agentic AI solutions in production.

- Collaborate with network domain experts, data engineers, and software teams to integrate agentic solutions into real-time network environments.

- Translate network objectives into data-driven, self-adapting models using reinforcement learning and emerging AI tools.

- Stay up to date on innovations in agentic AI, reinforcement learning, and telecom network automation.

Qualifications
You are eager to learn and can adapt quickly, both technically and personally. You have strong analytical skills and take ownership of your work. You enjoy working with both technical and non-technical colleagues and can make complex ideas easy to understand.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

- A strong background in software engineering (e.g. designing, building, and operating distributed systems in production).

- Solid experience with Python and/or Java, including writing clean, testable, and maintainable code.

- Hands-on experience applying AI/ML techniques in production, not just experimentation (e.g. model deployment, monitoring, lifecycle management).

- Experience with AI/ML frameworks and the ability to integrate models into larger software systems.

- Understanding of end-to-end AI systems, including data pipelines, model serving, monitoring, and feedback loops.

- Familiarity with cloud-native architectures (e.g. containerization, CI/CD, scalable services) and building reliable platforms.

- Interest in reinforcement-learning and agentic AI, actively exploring emerging frameworks and research to advance to autonomous solutions.

Drive Real Impact in Global Supply Chain Planning

Curious about how planning decisions shape business performance and customer experience? This internship gives you the chance to dive deep into supply chain planning in a truly international environment. You will work side by side with experienced professionals, gaining hands-on exposure to data analysis, planning processes, and cross-functional collaboration.

Your work will help improve visibility, coordination, and performance across the supply chain, supporting effective decision-making that impacts customers worldwide. If you have an analytical mindset, a structured approach, and a drive to learn, this opportunity will equip you with practical skills and insights for your future career in supply chain management.

This role is offered onsite in our Resmed Amsterdam office located at Herikerbergweg 292-342, Amsterdam 1101 CT.

What You’ll Do

Support supply chain planning activities by helping maintain planning inputs, assumptions, and working files.
Analyse supply chain data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring follow-up.
Assist in preparing reports, dashboards, and summaries that provide visibility into planning performance and business priorities.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support timely communication, alignment, and issue resolution.
Help maintain accurate data in planning and business systems through regular checks and updates.
Contribute to analysis and improvement activities that support more effective planning processes.
Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to standardise processes, reduce manual work, and improve visibility.
Prepare clear presentations or decision-support materials for team discussions, reviews, and stakeholder updates.
Learn and apply core supply chain planning concepts in a practical business environment.

What You Bring

Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s final year or Master’s programme in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Analytics, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
Available for a 6-month non-thesis internship based in Amsterdam.
Professional fluency in English
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with data and translate findings into clear insights.
Comfortable using Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to Power BI, Tableau, Oracle, SAP, or other planning/data tools is a plus.
Structured, proactive, and eager to learn in a fast-moving supply chain environment.
Good communication skills and willingness to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
Interest in supply chain planning, inventory management, logistics, and process improvement.

What Sets You Apart

Analytical Curiosity: You dive into data and uncover patterns that inform better decisions.
Structured Thinking: You organize complex information to drive clarity and action.
Collaborative Mindset: You value teaming up with different experts to solve problems.
Growth Orientation: You seek learning opportunities and embrace new challenges.
Attention to Detail: You understand that accuracy underpins effective planning.

This internship offers real-world experience, mentorship, and an inclusive environment where your ideas can make an impact, whether it’s optimizing supply chains or supporting innovations that help people sleep, breathe, and live better.

Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

- Defining R&D strategies: Helping clients shape their long-term vision and roadmap for R&D and digital transformation.

Are you an MSc student in Mechanical Engineering with an interest in precision mechanics, dynamics and mechatronic system design? Do you want to work on a challenging motion system in which accuracy, speed, stiffness and control all come together? We are looking for you!
Your assignment
In high-end printing systems, accurate sheet positioning underneath the printheads is essential for achieving excellent image quality. The Registration Unit is a highly dynamic system that ensures each sheet is aligned with great precision during transport. It can measure and correct multiple sheets per second in three degrees of freedom.
This alignment is achieved by four separately actuated wheels that must work together kinematically to continuously correct the sheet’s position and orientation on the fly. Several optical sensors accurately track the movement of the sheet. At the same time, the system requires highly accurate calibration, which is challenging due to the influence of mechanical tolerances and system complexity.
The registration unit consists of many mechanical parts with their own tolerances, and the kinematics of the system plays an important role in determining its overall performance. Therefore, a robust calibration method is needed to reduce the impact of mechanical tolerances on system performance.
Your assignment is to gain insight into the relevant tolerances and kinematics, improve the calibration procedure, and develop an automated calibration approach. You will implement and test your design (Matlab/Simulink) and demonstrate the performance in a real-life test setup.

You have affinity with precision mechanics, dynamics and motion systems
You enjoy combining system thinking with detailed mechanical design
You have experience with modelling, calculations and preferably simulation tools
You are interested in mechatronic design, including actuation and control aspects
